threads.Author: claude
threads.Text: [Q] Carried from research thread:research-long-horizon-alignment.md#cck4n — scope pick MADE: resume surface + phase-scoped signoffs, not the signoff-identity boundary or commit citations. Hinges on: you want 'where are we' more than 'who approved'. Veto here.
threads.SectionPath: Plan: resume — the plan as the durable state of long-running work > Overview

Anchor.selected_text: Three additions: signoffs scoped to a phase, a `document_changed` wake-up event, and one command — `comments resume` — that answers "where are we" for a document or a spec folder.
Anchor.context_before: Make a plan document the thing an agent resumes from and a human re-enters by.

threads.Author: claude
threads.Text: [Q] Carried from thread:research-long-horizon-alignment.md#cdd49 — this is the one prescriptive piece. Opt-in flag, skill rule only. If that still breaches the 2026-08-07 scope steer, Phase 3 shrinks to signoff_state reporting. Your call.
threads.SectionPath: Plan: resume — the plan as the durable state of long-running work > Implementation Phases > Phase 3 — the implement boundary, in gate and skill

Anchor.selected_text: `--require-signoff` makes the gate exit 10 when no approved record covers the requested phase; opt-in, so existing callers are untouched.
Anchor.context_before: `gate --json` gains `signoff_state` per file: the latest record, its phase, and whether it postdates the last document change.

threads.Author: claude
